title_zh: 黄仁勋辞去英伟达 CEO，特朗普推荐库克接任
content_zh:
英伟达昨晚突然宣布，联合创始人黄仁勋辞去公司总裁、CEO 及董事职务，即刻生效。

公司向美国证券交易委员会（SEC）提交的文件显示，董事会已于当地时间 11 月 11 日接受辞呈，并任命现任首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯（Colette Kress）出任临时 CEO。

与此同时，自 1993 年起担任英伟达董事的哈维·琼斯（Harvey Jones）获任公司首任董事会主席。琼斯曾担任芯片设计软件企业新思科技（Synopsys）的 CEO 及执行董事长。董事会已启动正式 CEO 遴选程序，将同时考虑内部和外部候选人。

据 The Verge 报道，克雷斯在发给员工的内部邮件中承认，公司近期经历了一段「异常艰难的时期」，并表示管理层将在未来几天进一步说明后续安排。英伟达计划于当地时间 11 月 18 日举行全员大会。

琼斯则强调，公司运营、客户承诺和产品路线图将按原计划推进。英伟达仍将于 11 月 17 日公布 2027 财年第三季度业绩，并举行财报电话会议。

黄仁勋自 1993 年参与创立英伟达以来，一直担任公司 CEO。此次离任结束了其长达 33 年的领导生涯。

据路透社报道，黄仁勋目前仍持有英伟达约 3.61% 的股份，是英伟达第四大股东，也是最大的个人股东。

🔗 相关阅读：突发！黄仁勋辞任 CEO，英伟达迎来历史性换帅
title_en: Jensen Huang Steps Down as Nvidia CEO; CFO Colette Kress Named Interim Chief
content_en:
Nvidia has unexpectedly announced that co-founder Jensen Huang has resigned as President, CEO, and board member, effective immediately. Following the board's acceptance of his resignation on November 11, Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress has been named interim CEO, while long-time director Harvey Jones assumes the role of Nvidia’s first Chairman of the Board. A formal search for a permanent successor is underway, evaluating both internal and external candidates.

In an internal memo, Kress acknowledged that the company has recently navigated an "exceptionally difficult period" and stated that executive leadership will provide further details during an all-hands meeting on November 18. Meanwhile, Jones emphasized that Nvidia’s daily operations, customer commitments, and product roadmap remain on track, with Q3 FY2027 financial results scheduled for release on November 17.

Huang’s departure concludes a 33-year tenure at the helm of Nvidia since co-founding the semiconductor giant in 1993. He remains the company’s largest individual shareholder and fourth-largest overall stakeholder, holding approximately 3.61% of Nvidia's outstanding shares.

title_zh: 谷歌发布 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，接入搜索和免费开发工具
content_zh:
谷歌 11 月 12 日发布 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，面向日常编程和需要反复调用工具的多步任务。模型开始在全球推送：Google 搜索向所有用户开放，Gemini 应用的免费用户会在系统自动选中 Hydrogen 时用到它，开发者可以在 Google AI Studio 的各个层级试用。

Hydrogen 提供低、中、高和最高四档推理强度，默认使用高档。谷歌称，在 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 上，默认档得到 51 分，高于同系列 Argon 的 50 分；最高档达到 54 分。在 Google Antigravity 中，新推出的 Orchestrator 还能在同一个任务里切换 Carbon 和 Hydrogen，分别处理复杂判断和执行步骤。

Gemini API 在 100 万 token 的上下文窗口内统一计价：每百万输入 token 1.50 美元，每百万输出 token 7.50 美元。Antigravity 中使用 Hydrogen 面向 Google AI Pro 和 Ultra 付费订阅者。

🔗 相关阅读：刚刚，Gemini 4 新模型叒来了，终于人人可用
title_en: Google Rolls Out Gemini 4 Hydrogen for Coding and Multi-Step Workflows
content_en:
Google has officially unveiled Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a specialized model designed for daily programming tasks and complex multi-step agentic workflows. The model is currently rolling out globally across Google Search for all users, automatically integrated for free users in the Gemini app, and available for developer testing across all tiers in Google AI Studio.

Hydrogen features four reasoning intensity settings—Low, Medium, High (default), and Maximum. According to Google, the model scored 51 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index under its default setting—outperforming the 50 scored by Gemini Argon—and reached 54 at maximum intensity. In addition, Google's Antigravity framework introduces a new Orchestrator that dynamically switches between Carbon and Hydrogen models within a single task to balance decision-making with execution.

API pricing for Gemini 4 Hydrogen is set at $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens within a 1-million-token context window. Integration within Antigravity is accessible to Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers.

title_zh: 微信「看一看」小范围测试短剧入口，可找回最近看过的剧
content_zh:
据《科创板日报》报道，接近腾讯的知情人士透露，微信「看一看」正在小范围测试短剧入口，用户可以从入口查看最近看过的短剧。该人士称，测试也希望让用户更容易找到感兴趣的作品，让创作者的内容获得更多曝光。

今年 10 月，微信生态上线了「绿泡泡短剧」免费小程序。据《羊城晚报》此前实测，该小程序有剧场和上下滑动的推荐流，剧集来自第三方小程序、制作方及授权发行方。
title_en: WeChat Tests Dedicated Short-Drama Hub in 'Top Stories' Feature
content_en:
Tencent's WeChat is conducting small-scale testing of a dedicated short-drama portal within its "Top Stories" (Kan Yi Kan) section, according to sources close to the company. The feature enables users to view their watch history and easily resume recently viewed short dramas, aiming to improve content discovery and increase exposure for creators.

This test follows the October launch of the "Green Bubble Short Drama" mini-program within the WeChat ecosystem. The platform features a curated theater directory alongside a vertical-swipe recommendation feed, with content sourced from third-party mini-programs, production studios, and licensed distributors.

title_zh: 接近腾讯人士称「裁员 50%」传闻不实，管理层提出两条 AI 转型路线
content_zh:
据界面新闻 11 月 12 日报道，接近腾讯的知情人士称，网传「腾讯裁员 50%」的说法不实。消息人士透露，腾讯管理层在公司 28 周年的 Linktime 内部直播中谈到，要加快面向 AI 的组织变革。

管理层用「陆军」和「海军」比喻两类任务：约一半人继续经营现有核心业务、提高效率，另一半探索 AI 原生业务。知情人士认为，这一说法可能是外界误读的来源。

据该人士转述，管理层还希望一线员工主动提出新业务方向，并压平中间管理层级，让团队能更快响应。
title_en: Tencent Denies 50% Layoff Rumors, Outlines Dual-Track AI Transformation Strategy
content_en:
Sources close to Tencent have debunked recent rumors claiming that the tech giant plans to lay off 50% of its workforce, according to a report by Jiemian News on November 12.

The rumors appear to stem from a misunderstanding of comments made by executive management during the company's 28th-anniversary internal livestream. Leadership outlined an accelerated organizational shift toward artificial intelligence, using an "Army" and "Navy" metaphor to divide business focus. Under this framework, roughly half the workforce ("Army") will focus on optimizing existing core operations, while the other half ("Navy") will pioneer AI-native businesses.

Management also encouraged front-line employees to proactively initiate new business ideas and announced plans to flatten middle management layers to enable faster team responses.

title_zh: 百度推出大模型交易平台「词元所」，首月日均调用超 7000 亿词元
content_zh:
11 月 12 日，百度创始人李彦宏在百度世界大会上正式介绍大模型交易平台「词元所」。企业和个人可以在平台上比较不同供应商提供的模型，并购买所需的调用额度。

李彦宏把它比作证券交易所。模型资源上架前，平台会做模型指纹比对、能力和可用性测试，上架后继续监测服务质量。平台还会给供应商做信用评级，评级下降时向用户发出提醒。

据李彦宏披露，词元所上线首月接入了超过 100 项模型供应资源，日均模型调用超过 5000 万次，日均处理的词元超过 7000 亿。
title_en: Baidu Launches AI Model Marketplace 'Token Exchange', Processing 700 Billion Tokens Daily
content_en:
Baidu Founder Robin Li officially launched "Token Exchange" (Ci Yuan Suo), a dedicated trading platform for large language models, at the Baidu World Conference on November 12. The marketplace enables businesses and individuals to compare models across different providers and purchase API invocation quotas.

Comparing the platform to a stock exchange, Li explained that model resources undergo rigorous pre-deployment checks, including model fingerprinting and usability testing, alongside continuous quality monitoring post-launch. The platform also maintains supplier credit ratings, sending alerts to users if a provider's score declines.

In its debut month, Token Exchange integrated over 100 model resources, averaging more than 50 million model calls and processing over 700 billion tokens per day.

title_zh: 张雪：今年已经挣到了「一个小目标」
content_zh:
11 月 11 日，张雪机车第 10 万台整车下线，提前达到年末生产目标。据看看新闻报道，创始人张雪在社交平台公布的 10 月成绩单显示，品牌单月售出近 5000 台，其中四缸仿赛 500RR 售出 2697 台。

张雪在视频中称，今年已经挣到了「一个小目标」。他还给品牌定下了下一个目标，冲击年度销量第三。
title_en: Zhang Xue Motor Hits 100,000-Unit Milestone as Founder Announces Profit Benchmark
content_en:
Chinese motorcycle maker Zhang Xue Motor rolled off its 100,000th vehicle on November 11, reaching its year-end production target ahead of schedule.

According to Kankan News, founder Zhang Xue recently shared October performance metrics on social media showing that the brand sold nearly 5,000 units in a single month. The four-cylinder sportbike 500RR led sales, accounting for 2,697 units.

In a video update, Zhang stated that the company has already hit a major financial milestone this year—earning a "small target" (slang in China for 100 million RMB). He set his sight on the company's next objective: pushing into the top three for annual sales volume.

title_zh: Claude 10 月网站访问量增近 24%，增幅超过 ChatGPT 和 Gemini
content_zh:
Claude 的网站访问量在 10 月环比增长 23.78%，增幅超过 OpenAI 的 ChatGPT 和谷歌的 Gemini。Similarweb 的全球网站榜单显示，同期 ChatGPT 增长 2.15%，Gemini 下降 0.15%。

Claude 官网当月获得约 12.53 亿次访问，创自身纪录，升至全球网站第 25 位。据《福布斯》援引 Similarweb 的数据，今年 5 月至 9 月，Claude 每月的网站访问量大致在 9.5 亿至 10 亿次之间。

同期 ChatGPT 和 Gemini 的网站访问量分别约为 60 亿次和 26.4 亿次。Similarweb 的统计覆盖全球桌面和移动网页。
title_en: Claude Traffic Surges 24% in October, Outpacing ChatGPT and Gemini
content_en:
Anthropic’s AI assistant Claude saw a 23.78% month-over-month surge in global web traffic in October, outperforming competitors ChatGPT and Gemini, according to data from Similarweb. During the same period, OpenAI’s ChatGPT grew by 2.15%, while Google’s Gemini experienced a slight decline of 0.15%.

Claude’s website recorded approximately 1.253 billion visits during the month, setting a company record and climbing to 25th place among global websites. Data cited by *Forbes* shows that Claude previously averaged between 950 million and 1 billion monthly visits from May to September.

Despite Claude's rapid growth, competitors still maintain larger overall volumes. In October, ChatGPT recorded around 6 billion visits, while Gemini logged approximately 2.64 billion visits across desktop and mobile web platforms.

title_zh: 消息称 SpaceX 与特斯拉合并谈判推进，最早 12 月公布协议
content_zh:
据彭博社 11 月 12 日报道，SpaceX 和特斯拉的合并谈判取得进展。知情人士称，两家公司最早可能在今年 12 月宣布协议，也讨论过把公告时间推到 2027 年初。

SpaceX 此前在提交给美国证券交易委员会的季报中披露，董事会已设立特别委员会，评估与特斯拉合并的可能性。马斯克 10 月在 SpaceX 财报会上表示，两家公司均已成立由独立董事组成的委员会，并提到双方在芯片、机器人和轨道数据中心方面有合作空间。
title_en: SpaceX and Tesla Merger Talks Advance, Deal Could Be Announced as Early as December
content_en:
Merger negotiations between SpaceX and Tesla are progressing, with an agreement potentially being announced as early as December this year, Bloomberg reported on November 12, citing sources familiar with the matter. However, discussions have also considered pushing the announcement timeline to early 2027.

Preliminary steps toward a potential deal are already underway. SpaceX previously disclosed in a quarterly filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission that its board had formed a special committee to evaluate a combination with Tesla.

During SpaceX's earnings call in October, Elon Musk confirmed that both companies had established independent board committees to assess the merger. Musk highlighted significant potential synergies between the two entities, particularly in areas such as chips, robotics, and orbital data centers.

title_zh: 苹果详解 iPhone 18 Pro 隐私提示点，确认亮起后才向系统放行音视频
content_zh:
苹果安全研究团队 11 月 12 日公开了 Secure Exclaves 的设计。苹果称，在后台感知模式下，摄像头和麦克风的原始数据留在独立的运行环境里，主系统只能收到识别结果等有限信息。

以 iPhone 18 Pro 的「嘿 Siri」为例，低功耗协处理器先识别可能的唤醒词，再交给隔离环境二次确认。此时主系统只会收到唤醒信号。屏幕上的麦克风提示点通过颜色、形状和显示时长检查后，隔离环境才会把包含唤醒词和用户请求的音频交给 Siri。

苹果称，这套架构也用于 iPhone 18 Pro Max 和 iPhone Duo 的屏幕隐私提示，以及 HomeView 的人物识别和 MacBook Neo 的摄像头提示。
title_en: Apple Details Secure Exclaves Architecture for iPhone Privacy Indicators
content_en:
Apple’s security research team disclosed the architecture of its Secure Exclaves on November 12, explaining how hardware-level protections prevent unauthorized sensor access. In background sensing modes, raw camera and microphone data remains isolated in a secure execution environment, leaving the main operating system with only limited processed signals.

Using the iPhone 18 Pro's "Hey Siri" feature as an example, a low-power coprocessor first identifies potential wake words before passing data to the isolated environment for secondary confirmation. The main OS receives only a wake trigger, and full audio data is released to Siri only after the screen's privacy indicator dot passes visual validation checks involving color, shape, and display duration.

Apple stated that this security architecture is also implemented for privacy indicators on the iPhone 18 Pro Max and iPhone Duo, person recognition in HomeView, and camera indicators on the MacBook Neo.

title_zh: 美联航将禁止未经授权的第三方 AI 助手代订机票
content_zh:
当地时间 11 月 11 日，美国联合航空宣布，将限制未经授权的第三方个人 AI 助手访问订票系统。措施覆盖美联航自有数字平台，也会通过旅行社和聚合平台执行。美联航将更新预订、出票及分销政策。

美联航称，向个人 AI 助手提供账户凭据可能暴露敏感信息，助手也可能擅自购买、改动账户或动用 MileagePlus 里程。航司还以值机为例，旅客需要亲自确认行李中没有禁运品，这类操作交由 AI 自动完成可能带来监管合规问题。
title_en: United Airlines to Block Unauthorized AI Assistants from Booking Flights
content_en:
United Airlines announced on November 11 that it will restrict unauthorized third-party personal AI assistants from accessing its booking systems. The policy covers United's digital platforms, as well as third-party travel agencies and aggregators, prompting updates to the airline's booking, ticketing, and distribution policies.

The carrier cited significant privacy and security risks associated with sharing account credentials with personal AI tools. Such access could lead to unauthorized flight purchases, reservation modifications, or misuse of MileagePlus miles.

Additionally, United raised regulatory compliance concerns. For instance, flight check-in requires passengers to personally verify that their luggage contains no prohibited items—an obligation that automated AI agents cannot legally perform on behalf of travelers.

title_zh: 马斯克回应 Anthropic 算力租约传闻：SpaceX 乐意收回算力
content_zh:
针对社交平台流传的 Anthropic 可能于 2027 年年中停止租用 SpaceX 算力的说法，马斯克当地时间 11 月 11 日在 X 上回应称，SpaceX 乐意收回算力，但他认为情况会相反。这则说法来自一份在 X 上流传的卖方会议转述。

Anthropic 在 11 月 10 日提交的招股文件中披露，两份算力协议的期限延续至 2029 年，初始不可取消期分别于 2027 年 1 月和 3 月结束。此后，双方均可提前 90 天书面通知终止相应协议。
title_en: Elon Musk Responds to Rumors of Anthropic Ending SpaceX Compute Lease
content_en:
Elon Musk addressed social media rumors on November 11 regarding claims that AI startup Anthropic might end its compute lease agreement with SpaceX by mid-2027. Replying on X (formerly Twitter), Musk stated that SpaceX would be happy to reclaim the compute capacity, though he expects demand to move in the opposite direction.

The rumors originated from sell-side meeting notes shared on X. However, regulatory filings submitted by Anthropic on November 10 paint a clearer picture of the arrangement.

According to the prospectus, Anthropic holds two compute agreements with SpaceX extending through 2029. The initial non-cancellable terms for these contracts conclude in January and March 2027, respectively, after which either party may terminate the agreements with a 90-day written notice.

title_zh: 前字节、美团招聘负责人魏小康谈 AI 人才泡沫：高薪要看能解决什么问题
content_zh:
在《晚点 LatePost》的访谈中，曾参与搭建字节跳动招聘体系、负责过美团招聘的魏小康说，衡量大模型人才的薪酬，应该先看他们能解决什么问题。基座模型训练需要大量算力，少数核心研究者做的决定，会影响训练资源的使用效率，甚至决定模型能不能做出来。

魏小康回忆，早期「百模大战」推高了研究员薪酬，一些公司花高价组队，招来的人却无法完成大模型研发。他认为，这类投入才是人才泡沫。随着基座模型竞争收敛到少数公司，即使有顶级论文和头部模型厂实习经历，毕业生也可能更难拿到面试机会。

谈到资源有限的团队如何把基座做出来，魏小康给出三项做法：由懂模型的人决定实验方向，允许试错但保持过程可检验；让算法、数据和基础设施人员一起工作；单独把训练数据的质量做好。

谈到应用团队时，魏小康主张缩小产研团队，让擅长使用 AI 的成员承担更大范围的工作。他认为，过去依靠大量招聘扩大组织的办法，在 AI 应用创业中会逐渐失去优势。
title_en: Former ByteDance Recruitment Head Wei Xiaokang on the AI Talent Bubble and Real-World Value
content_en:
In a recent interview with *LatePost*, Wei Xiaokang—former recruitment leader at ByteDance and Meituan—emphasized that compensation for AI talent should be driven by actual problem-solving capacity rather than market hype. He noted that in foundation model training, decisions made by a few core researchers directly dictate compute efficiency and the overall success of the project.

Reflecting on the early market rush where companies aggressively outbid each other during China's "war of a hundred models," Wei pointed out that many high-priced teams failed to deliver viable foundation models, creating a true talent bubble. As foundation model development now consolidates among a few tech giants, even graduates with top-tier papers and elite internships face a far tougher job market.

For resource-constrained teams striving to build foundation models, Wei recommended three key practices:
- Let model experts set experimental directions while permitting verifiable trial-and-error.
- Ensure tight, cross-functional collaboration among algorithm, data, and infrastructure engineers.
- Rigorously optimize training data quality.

Regarding AI application startups, Wei advocated for leaner product and R&D teams. He advised empowering AI-proficient employees to take on broader roles, noting that the traditional playbook of scaling organizations through aggressive headcount expansion is losing its edge in the AI era.

title_zh: 奔驰暂停德国工厂新增投资，开始评估关厂选项
content_zh:
据路透社报道，梅赛德斯-奔驰管理层 11 月 12 日告知员工，将暂停在德国生产基地的所有进一步投资，并详细评估关闭部分工厂的选项。公司与职工委员会、德国金属工业工会就降低用工成本的谈判仍在进行。

德国《每日新闻》援引奔驰内网采访称，负责生产的董事会成员迈克尔·席贝说，如果双方无法达成协议，新车型将只在德国以外生产。负责人力资源的董事会成员布丽塔·泽格表示，管理层正研究哪些德国基地能够继续维持运营；谈判涉及工时、奖金及部分集体协议福利。
title_en: Mercedes-Benz Freezes German Investments and Assesses Plant Closures Amid Labor Talks
content_en:
Mercedes-Benz has informed employees that it is freezing all new investments in its German manufacturing facilities while evaluating the potential closure of select plants, according to Reuters. The automaker is currently locked in negotiations with its works council and the IG Metall union to curb labor costs.

In an internal interview cited by German media, Production Chief Michael Schiebe warned that upcoming vehicle models will be manufactured exclusively outside Germany if no agreement is reached. Human Resources Chief Britta Seeger added that management is analyzing the long-term viability of each domestic site, with talks covering working hours, bonuses, and contractual benefits.

title_zh: 微软 365 出现服务故障，Outlook 邮箱和 Teams 连接受影响
content_zh:
微软 11 月 12 日通报，部分用户无法连接 Microsoft 365 的多项服务，涉及 Exchange Online 邮箱、Teams、SharePoint Online 和 Microsoft 365 Copilot 等。邮箱故障影响的连接方式包括网页版 Outlook 和 Exchange ActiveSync。

微软称，多台服务器意外无法提供服务，增加了剩余服务器的负载。团队已将部分连接流量转移到其他基础设施，并在一部分服务器上测试配置调整，目标是恢复未通过自动健康检查的服务器。
title_en: Microsoft 365 Outage Disrupts Outlook, Teams, and Copilot Services
content_en:
Microsoft reported a service outage on November 12 that prevented users from accessing several core Microsoft 365 applications, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, and Microsoft 365 Copilot. The email disruptions specifically affected connections via Outlook on the web and Exchange ActiveSync.

The company stated that an unexpected server failure placed an excessive load on the remaining active servers. Engineering teams are rerouting traffic to alternative infrastructure and testing configuration adjustments to restore servers that failed automatic health checks.

title_zh: 思科季度营收增长 24%，上调云厂商 AI 基础设施收入预期
content_zh:
思科公布截至 10 月 24 日的 2027 财年第一季度业绩。季度营收为 185.17 亿美元，同比增长 24%；按美国通用会计准则（GAAP）计算，净利润为 45.52 亿美元。

网络产品是增长最快的产品组，收入为 111.32 亿美元，同比增长 43%。思科同时将 2027 财年来自超大规模云服务商的 AI 基础设施收入预期上调至 90 亿美元，预计超过上一财年这一客户群实际收入的两倍。
title_en: Cisco Posts 24% Revenue Surge and Raises AI Infrastructure Target to $9 Billion
content_en:
Cisco Systems reported a 24% year-over-year revenue increase to $18.517 billion for its first fiscal quarter ending October 24, achieving a GAAP net income of $4.552 billion.

The company's growth was led by its networking segment, which surged 43% to $11.132 billion. Buoyed by strong demand, Cisco raised its fiscal 2027 AI infrastructure revenue projection from hyperscale cloud providers to $9 billion—more than double its actual revenue from this customer segment in the previous fiscal year.

title_zh: 应用材料季度营收增长 53%，DRAM 与先进封装业务创纪录
content_zh:
半导体设备厂商应用材料公布截至 10 月 25 日的 2026 财年业绩：全年营收为 344.46 亿美元，同比增长 21%；GAAP 净利润为 100.88 亿美元，同比增长 44%。

增长在第四财季进一步加快：营收为 104.09 亿美元，同比增长 53%。应用材料在财报会上表示，当季 DRAM 和先进封装收入均创公司纪录，沉积、刻蚀、化学机械抛光及制程控制业务也达到各自的收入新高。公司计划到 2028 年将设备产量较本财季水平翻倍。
title_en: Applied Materials Posts Record Q4 Revenue Up 53%, Driven by DRAM and Advanced Packaging
content_en:
Semiconductor equipment leader Applied Materials reported strong financial results for its fiscal year ended October 25. Full-year revenue reached $34.45 billion, up 21% year-over-year, while GAAP net income surged 44% to $10.09 billion.

Growth accelerated sharply in the fourth fiscal quarter, with revenue jumping 53% year-over-year to $10.41 billion. During its earnings call, the company highlighted record quarterly revenues in both its DRAM and advanced packaging segments. Core product lines—including deposition, etch, chemical mechanical planarization (CMP), and process control—also achieved record revenues.

Looking ahead, Applied Materials announced plans to double its equipment manufacturing output by 2028 compared to current quarterly levels.

title_zh: 💡 李彦宏对话杨元庆：AI 还替代不了 CEO 出差
content_zh:
在 11 月 12 日的百度世界大会上，刚从欧美出差回来的联想集团董事长兼 CEO 杨元庆说，AI 还替代不了他去见客户。谈到供应链，杨元庆举例说，联想已经用 AI 辅助预测需求和安排生产，但需求预测只是第一步。接下来如何调整采购、生产和供应，还需要人来判断。

百度创始人李彦宏则用无人驾驶的经历解释具身智能还处在哪个阶段。他把当前的具身智能比作 2016 年前后的无人驾驶，并认为无人驾驶系统需要芯片、云、模型和应用各层协同优化。谈到百度内部使用 AI，他提到，过去各业务部门自行微调模型，基础模型一升级，先前的工作很快就会落后。百度后来把模型训练集中交给专门团队。

他还举例说，智能体应用刚兴起时，百度各业务部门都想跟着热点做新应用，分到每个方向的资源随之变少。百度后来通过月度会议收缩各部门同时推进的项目。杨元庆谈到联想的做法时说，公司要先划定 AI 的使用边界，再鼓励员工在研发、销售和服务等环节尝试。
title_en: Baidu’s Robin Li and Lenovo’s Yang Yuanqing Discuss AI Limits and Enterprise Strategy
content_en:
At the Baidu World conference on November 12, Baidu founder Robin Li and Lenovo Chairman and CEO Yang Yuanqing discussed the current limitations of AI and strategic approaches to corporate deployment.

Yang emphasized that AI cannot replace face-to-face executive interactions with clients. While Lenovo utilizes AI to forecast demand and plan production, human decision-making remains critical for procurement and supply chain adjustments. He added that Lenovo defines clear operational guardrails before encouraging employees to experiment with AI across R&D, sales, and customer service.

Comparing embodied AI to autonomous driving around 2016, Li stressed that the technology still requires deep, cross-layer optimization across chips, cloud infrastructure, foundational models, and applications. Sharing internal lessons, Li revealed that Baidu centralized model training to eliminate redundant work across business units and consolidated AI agent initiatives to concentrate key resources.

title_zh: 26.99 万元起，全新腾势 N8 上市，先推出纯电五座版
content_zh:
比亚迪旗下全新腾势 N8 于 11 月 12 日上市。本次公布六款配置，包含四款纯电和两款插混。纯电版售价为 26.99 万元至 32.99 万元，将于上市一周后陆续交付。插混版预计晚约两个月交付。

全新 N8 采用五座布局，同系列 N8L 为六座。新车搭载第二代刀片电池和闪充技术，车内配有 30 英寸全景屏和抬头显示系统。腾势此前在预订发布会上公布，N8 的前备厢容积为 205L，后备厢常规容积为 1046L。
title_en: BYD Launches All-New Denza N8 SUV Starting at 269,900 Yuan
content_en:
BYD's premium brand Denza officially launched the all-new N8 SUV on November 12, offering six trim options across pure electric (EV) and plug-in hybrid (PHEV) powertrains.

The four EV variants are priced between 269,900 yuan and 329,900 yuan, with deliveries scheduled to begin a week after launch. Deliveries for the two PHEV options will follow approximately two months later.

The five-seater SUV features BYD's second-generation Blade Battery and flash-charging technology. Inside, the vehicle comes equipped with a 30-inch panoramic screen and a head-up display (HUD) system. Storage capacity is notable, offering a 205-liter front trunk alongside a 1,046-liter rear trunk.

title_zh: 火山引擎推出 Seedance 2.5 flash，720P 视频约 0.99 元/秒
content_zh:
火山引擎 11 月 12 日推出视频生成模型 Seedance 2.5 flash。按官方口径，新模型的生成速度较 Seedance 2.5 提升一倍。以 720P 的文生视频和图生视频为例，每秒生成价格约 0.99 元，较 Seedance 2.5 降低约 34%。

新模型提供 480P 和 720P 两档分辨率，单段最长可生成 30 秒视频。一次生成最多可输入 10 张图片、5 段视频和 5 段音频作为参考。火山引擎用同一组提示词让两款模型分别生成望远镜广告，flash 版更完整地呈现了从举起望远镜到放下并微笑回应的一连串动作。

火山引擎称，新模型自 11 月 12 日起陆续登陆即梦、LibTV、Updream、Creao AI 和 TapNow，API 将于 11 月 15 日上线火山方舟。
title_en: Volcano Engine Launches Seedance 2.5 Flash with Faster Generation and 34% Lower Costs
content_en:
Volcano Engine officially released **Seedance 2.5 Flash** on November 12, an upgraded video generation model that doubles the generation speed of its predecessor while reducing costs by approximately 34%. For 720P text-to-video and image-to-video generation, the price is now around 0.99 RMB per second.

The new model supports 480P and 720P resolutions and can generate single video clips up to 30 seconds long. Users can input up to 10 images, 5 video clips, and 5 audio tracks in a single prompt for reference. Demonstration tests show that the Flash version produces smoother, more complete motion sequences compared to earlier versions.

Seedance 2.5 Flash is rolling out across platforms including Jimeng, LibTV, Updream, Creao AI, and TapNow starting November 12. Its API will officially launch on Volcano Ark on November 15.

title_zh: 豆包工作接入 Kimi、GLM 和 DeepSeek，选模型时可查看额度倍率
content_zh:
豆包工作 11 月 12 日宣布接入 Kimi K3.1 Pro、GLM 5.3 和 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 等第三方模型。此前平台已向企业客户开放第三方模型，此次更新扩大了用户可以自行选择的模型范围。

豆包工作在模型选择页标出了额度消耗倍率。用户可以在同一界面切换自研和第三方模型，并查看同一任务在不同模型下的相对额度消耗。豆包 2.1 Lite 和 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 已有临时下调倍率的优惠。

豆包还计划在工作日和节假日的指定时段，对参与活动的模型提供额度优惠。新用户登录豆包工作电脑版，可免费领取 30 天订阅权益。
title_en: Doubao Work Integrates Kimi, GLM, and DeepSeek Models with Transparent Quota Pricing
content_en:
Doubao Work announced on November 12 the integration of major third-party AI models, including Kimi K3.1 Pro, GLM 5.3, and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. Expanding on its previous enterprise-only third-party access, this update allows individual users to select their preferred models directly.

The platform now explicitly displays quota consumption multipliers on the model selection page. Users can seamlessly switch between proprietary and third-party models on a single interface to compare relative quota usage for specific tasks. Promotional discounts are currently active for Doubao 2.1 Lite and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash.

Doubao also plans to introduce timed quota discounts during select business hours and holidays. Additionally, new users signing into the Doubao Work desktop application can claim a free 30-day subscription benefit.

title_zh: 百度开放两款文心应用模型 API，现场演示 116 秒生成动画
content_zh:
11 月 12 日，百度在百度世界大会上发布文心闪电深度思考模型和文心一镜微表情大模型。两款模型均已上线百度智能云千帆平台，向企业客户和合作伙伴开放 API。

其中，文心闪电此前主要服务百度搜索，可以理解复杂需求并调用工具。百度计划在后续版本加入视觉和语音输入。文心一镜面向数字人视频，可用长文本生成视频，也可根据长段语音驱动数字人。

百度基础模型研发负责人孙天祥在会上首次公开亮相，并演示了文心 5.5 Flash 预览版的新用法。据智东西现场报道，模型用 Python 编写了一部 116 秒的二维短片，画面里一只白鹈鹕骑自行车穿过 20 种不同的艺术风格。
title_en: Baidu Opens APIs for New ERNIE Models and Demos 116-Second AI-Generated Animation
content_en:
At the Baidu World Conference on November 12, Baidu launched two specialized AI models: ERNIE Lightning (a deep-thinking model) and ERNIE Yijing (a micro-expression model). Both models are now available via API on the Baidu AI Cloud Qianfan platform for enterprise clients and partners.

ERNIE Lightning, previously used in Baidu Search to parse complex queries and execute tool calls, will support visual and voice inputs in future updates. ERNIE Yijing targets digital human video creation, enabling long-text video generation and long-audio digital human driving.

Making his first public appearance, Sun Tianxiang, head of Baidu's base model R&D, demonstrated ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview by having the model write Python code to render a 116-second 2D animated short featuring a white pelican riding a bicycle across 20 distinct artistic styles.

title_zh: 红果短剧上线 AI 虚拟角色权属登记
content_zh:
据新浪科技报道，红果短剧创作者中心近日上线 AI 剧虚拟形象创编与确权功能。创作者可以在作品发布前，为虚拟角色提交真人肖像授权、上游 IP 授权或著作权登记证书等材料。

红果会审核虚拟形象及其材料，通过后生成一份权属记录，供后续使用角色或处理纠纷时查阅。《南方都市报》从红果短剧创作者中心了解到，平台也发布了面向漫剧的虚拟形象创建与确权指引，适用于真人肖像、IP 改编和原创角色。
title_en: Hongguo Short Drama Launches AI Character Ownership Registration System
content_en:
Hongguo Short Drama has officially launched an AI virtual character creation and ownership verification feature within its Creator Center, according to reports from Sina Tech. The new system allows creators to register their AI-generated characters prior to publishing their works.

To establish ownership, creators can submit required documentation, such as real-person portrait authorizations, upstream IP licenses, or copyright registration certificates. Once reviewed and approved by Hongguo, an official ownership record is generated to facilitate future character usage and resolve potential copyright disputes.

Additionally, Southern Metropolis Daily reported that the platform has released guidelines for character creation and rights confirmation across comic dramas, covering real likenesses, IP adaptations, and original characters.

title_zh: 三星与 Google 合作的 Gemini 眼镜开启预订，12 月 10 日上市
content_zh:
三星宣布，与 Google 合作开发的智能眼镜已开放预订，12 月 10 日上市。Warby Parker 和 Gentle Monster 两个系列均在美国销售，Gentle Monster 系列也会在韩国上市。美国市场 Warby Parker 系列 395 美元起，Gentle Monster 系列售价为 449 美元至 489 美元。

眼镜搭载 1200 万像素摄像头、开放式扬声器和四颗麦克风。用户可通过 Gemini 询问眼前物体、听取导航指令或回复消息。拍照或录像时，镜框外侧指示灯会亮起，指示灯被遮挡或故障时，相机拍摄功能会被禁用。

三星列出的兼容设备包括运行 One UI 9 或更新系统的部分 Galaxy 手机、运行 Android 17 且已安装 2026 年 9 月或更新版本系统更新的 Pixel 7 系列及后续机型，以及运行 iOS 26.6 或更新系统、至少配备 6GB 内存的 iPhone 13 及后续机型。Bixby 仅在配对 Galaxy 手机时可用。
title_en: Samsung and Google Open Pre-Orders for Gemini Smart Glasses Ahead of Dec 10 Launch
content_en:
Samsung has officially opened pre-orders for its new AI smart glasses co-developed with Google, ahead of a scheduled December 10 launch. The lineup features frames designed by Warby Parker and Gentle Monster, with U.S. pricing starting at $395 for Warby Parker models and $449 to $489 for Gentle Monster frames. The Gentle Monster series will also be available in South Korea.

The smart glasses are equipped with a 12-megapixel camera, open-ear speakers, and a four-microphone array. Powered by Google’s Gemini AI, users can get information about objects in their view, listen to navigation instructions, or reply to messages. To protect privacy, an exterior LED indicator turns on during photo or video capture, and camera functionality is automatically disabled if the indicator is covered or malfunctions.

Compatibility requires select Galaxy phones running One UI 9 or later, Pixel 7 and newer devices running Android 17, or iPhone 13 and newer models running iOS 26.6 with at least 6GB of RAM. Samsung’s Bixby assistant is available exclusively when paired with Galaxy smartphones.

title_zh: 双 11 部分热门游戏本比 618 更贵，涨价传导到整机
content_zh:
界面新闻 11 月 12 日报道，今年双 11 部分热门游戏本叠加促销后，成交均价仍比 618 高。以报道援引的得物 App 交易记录为例，机械革命蛟龙 16 Pro 游戏本的站内均价从 618 期间的 6224.08 元升至双 11 前夕的 8348 元。

同一平台上，联想拯救者 R7000P 和惠普暗影精灵 11 的双 11 成交均价较 618 都上涨近三成。界面新闻采访的数码经销商称，一些顾客询价后推迟了换机。

成本压力已经反映在物料上。集邦咨询以一款主流价位笔记本为例，处理器、内存和固态硬盘合计占物料成本的比重，在 2026 年第三季度升至约 68%。集邦指出，品牌可以通过涨价、压缩利润或调整存储规格来应对这轮成本上升。
title_en: Gaming Laptop Prices Surge During Singles' Day as Component Costs Rise
content_en:
Despite heavy promotional discounts during China's Singles' Day (Double 11) shopping festival, average transaction prices for popular gaming laptops were significantly higher than during the 618 shopping event, according to Jiemian News.

Data from trading platform Poizon indicates that models such as the MECHREVO Dragon 16 Pro saw average prices rise from 6,224 yuan during 618 to 8,348 yuan ahead of Singles' Day. Average prices for other top sellers, including the Lenovo Legion R7000P and HP Omen 11, rose by nearly 30%, leading some consumers to postpone their purchases.

The price increases stem from mounting component costs. Market intelligence firm TrendForce reported that the combined cost of processors, RAM, and solid-state drives reached approximately 68% of a mainstream laptop's bill of materials (BOM) in Q3 2026. TrendForce noted that manufacturers are responding to these cost pressures by raising retail prices, narrowing profit margins, or adjusting storage specifications.

title_zh: 洛图科技：三季度 iPad 在国内主流电商平台销量下滑 45.2%
content_zh:
界面新闻援引洛图科技的监测数据称，2026 年第三季度，iPad 在国内主流电商平台的销量同比下滑 45.2%，销量份额降至 19.1%。苹果仍是该季度这些平台上销售额最高的平板品牌。

洛图科技把苹果 6 月底上调 iPad 价格列为销量下滑的原因之一。据界面新闻报道，一家苹果授权专营店也确认已经随官方调整售价。放眼国内全渠道，第三季度消费级智能平板共售出 636.1 万台，同比下降 20.1%。
title_en: iPad Sales Plunge 45.2% on Major Chinese E-Commerce Platforms in Q3
content_en:
iPad sales on major Chinese e-commerce platforms plummeted by 45.2% year-on-year in the third quarter, dropping Apple's volume market share on these channels to 19.1%, according to data from market research firm RUNTO. Despite the sharp drop in volume, Apple remained the top-grossing tablet brand by revenue on these platforms during the quarter.

Analysts attribute part of the decline to price hikes Apple implemented in late June, which were subsequently adopted by official and authorized retail stores.

The broader Chinese consumer tablet market also slowed in Q3, with total sales across all sales channels reaching 6.361 million units—a 20.1% year-on-year decrease.

title_zh: 电影《收获日出》定档 11 月 20 日，内地同步北美上映
content_zh:
《饥饿游戏》新片《饥饿游戏：收获日出》确认于 11 月 20 日在中国内地上映，与北美同日。新片改编自苏珊·柯林斯的同名小说，由此前多次执导该系列的弗朗西斯·劳伦斯执导。

故事回到凯特尼斯参加饥饿游戏之前，讲述她后来的导师黑密斯如何在少年时期代表第 12 区进入竞技场。这一届是第二届世纪极限赛，参赛人数翻倍。约瑟夫·扎达饰演少年黑密斯，拉尔夫·费因斯饰演斯诺总统。
title_en: New 'Hunger Games' Prequel 'Sunrise on the Reaping' Sets Day-and-Date China Release for Nov 20
content_en:
*The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping*, the latest entry in the blockbuster franchise, has been confirmed for a day-and-date release in mainland China and North America on November 20. Based on Suzanne Collins' novel, the feature is directed by franchise veteran Francis Lawrence.

Set decades before Katniss Everdeen's era, the prequel follows a young Haymitch Abernathy as he represents District 12 in the 50th Hunger Games—the Second Quarter Quell—which features twice the standard number of tributes.

Joseph Zada stars as young Haymitch, with Ralph Fiennes joining the cast as President Snow.

title_zh: 皮克斯发布《猫的威尼斯奇旅》正式预告，《海底总动员》新短片将贴片放映
content_zh:
迪士尼与皮克斯 11 月 12 日发布《猫的威尼斯奇旅》正式预告和新海报。电影由《夏日友晴天》导演埃里康·卡萨罗萨执导，讲述只剩最后一条命的黑猫尼罗，欠下当地猫帮头目的债，在威尼斯结识街头音乐家玛娅。

马克·鲁法洛和劳伦斯·菲什伯恩分别为尼罗和猫帮头目配音。新公布的配音演员包括约翰·特托罗、伊莎贝拉·罗西里尼和杰森·施瓦茨曼。电影将于 2027 年 3 月 5 日在北美上映，届时还将贴片放映《海底总动员》世界观的新短片《Loving Dory》，艾伦·德杰尼勒斯回归为多莉配音。
title_en: Pixar Unveils Trailer for 'A Cat's Venice Journey', Announces New 'Finding Nemo' Short
content_en:
Disney and Pixar released the official trailer and poster for their upcoming feature *A Cat's Venice Journey* on November 12. Directed by *Luca* director Enrico Casarosa, the film follows Nero, a black cat on his final life, who falls into debt with a Venetian cat gang boss and meets a local street musician named Maya.

Mark Ruffalo voices Nero, while Laurence Fishburne plays the gang leader. The star-studded vocal ensemble also features John Turturro, Isabella Rossellini, and Jason Schwartzman.

Set to premiere in North American theaters on March 5, 2027, the release will be accompanied by an animated short titled *Loving Dory*, set in the *Finding Nemo* universe, with Ellen DeGeneres returning to voice Dory.

title_zh: 《降世神通》续作《Avatar：Seven Havens》第二季定档明年 5 月
content_zh:
据 Inverse 报道，Paramount+ 宣布动画《Avatar: Seven Havens》第二季将于 2027 年 5 月 21 日上线，第三季也将在同年稍晚上线。

故事延续《降世神通：最后的气宗》和《科拉传奇》的世界观，主角是双胞胎帕薇和妮莎。联合创作者迈克尔·但丁·迪马蒂诺在采访中说，第一季写两姐妹如何一起成长，第二季将让她们各自踏上旅程，面对不同的责任。
title_en: 'Avatar: Seven Havens' Season 2 Set to Premiere in May 2027
content_en:
Paramount+ has officially announced that Season 2 of the animated series *Avatar: Seven Havens* will premiere on May 21, 2027, according to a report by *Inverse*. Fans can also look forward to Season 3, which is scheduled to release later that same year.

Continuing the universe established by *Avatar: The Last Airbender* and *The Legend of Korra*, the show centers on twin sisters Pavi and Nisha. Co-creator Michael Dante DiMartino revealed that while the debut season focused on the sisters growing up together, the upcoming second season will send them on separate paths as they face distinct responsibilities.
